requirements.purpose: Test a customer support dashboard with varied synthetic tickets
requirements.field_description: ticket_id integer unique; category string chosen from billing, login, or delivery; priority string chosen from low, medium, or high; opened_date date; resolved boolean; summary string
requirements.constraints: Use fictional cases and include a mix of priorities and resolved values.

approved_plan.purpose: Test a customer support dashboard with varied synthetic tickets

fields.name: ticket_id
fields.description: Unique sequential identifier for each support ticket.

fields.name: category
fields.description: Ticket category. Allowed values: billing, login, delivery.

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Urgency level. Allowed values: low, medium, high.

fields.name: opened_date
fields.description: Date the ticket was created (YYYY-MM-DD format).

fields.name: resolved
fields.description: Whether the ticket has been resolved. Allowed values: true, false.

fields.name: summary
fields.description: Brief description of the customer issue.

approved_plan.generation_instructions: Generate two CSV files containing a total of 6 records (3 per file). Ensure all ticket_ids are unique integers. Mix categories, priorities, and resolved statuses across both files. Use fictional scenarios only; do not include real names, emails, addresses, or financial details.
